review_scope: Civil subset: NCPC Articles 432, 437 and 472 as reproduced in judiciary publications, with judicial-language legislation. The complete current code and criminal expert rules were not revalidated.

appointment.basis: Nouveau Code de procédure civile, art. 432
appointment.summary_en: A judge may select a technical expert to clarify a factual issue requiring specialist knowledge.

items_en: Address the parties' observations and objections within the assigned expert task.
Attach written observations if the parties request this.

rights_duties.summary_en: Carry out the assignment conscientiously, objectively and impartially.

timestamp.qualified_recognition: Qualified timestamps carry date/time accuracy and data-integrity presumptions; qualification requires the statutory conditions.

open_questions: Provider qualification, certificate status, national filing rules and supported signature formats must be checked separately; this profile does not qualify a TgWitness signature or timestamp.
This is a selected civil reference set, not an exhaustive statutory report checklist. Check the current NCPC and the appointment order.
A criminal route, expert oath and signing formula have not been verified; do not reuse this civil subset for criminal proceedings.
Report requirements are summarised in English. Native expert/law terms do not imply a complete reviewed translation of the report or interface.
court_language_notes: French, German or Luxembourgish may be used in judicial matters under the 1984 language law, subject to special provisions. Confirm the language required for the particular filing.
